tasks.prompt:
We need a complete development change in this pinned real project. Inspect the actual implementation and public reproduction first, explain the call path and edge cases, ask clarification questions, propose a compatibility-conscious plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate within the same conversation and workspace. The eventual delivery contract is:

Repair on_exception so exhausting a finite wait generator follows raise_on_giveup in both synchronous and asynchronous execution: False returns None; True (including the default) propagates the same last exception object. Preserve the exact number of target attempts, zero/finite waits, exactly one giveup callback with exception and tries, awaited async callbacks, handler-error propagation, ordinary success and on_predicate behavior. Do not add sleeping/network calls to tests, change unrelated retry policies, or intercept exceptions outside the configured exception type.

Deliver implementation, meaningful original-failing public tests at library/tests/test_development_exhaustion.py, and a concise compatibility document at library/docs/development-bf-exhaust-dev.md. Do not modify frozen original tests, dependency metadata, test controls, or any other paths.
